research_rationale:
Independent producer B review of the frozen full dossier and held original/actor source texts. Sections 1-3 establish continuing Treasury, bank-transfer and Federal Reserve authority with conditional transfers; an actual transfer does not exhaust the authority to address other assets or repayments. Neither an assumed transfer date nor UNSCR778 adoption is used as an end. The held chain identifies EO13350 as the express revocation, effective under its section 10 on July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT. Corrected exact spans separate section 2 from the OCR section 1 block and combine the empty section 8 heading with its two implementation paragraphs. Sections 1-8, including section 4 acquittance/nonliability/pre-transfer rights and section 6 redelegation/all-agency duties, are retained. The whole order is expressly named in EO13350 revocation. Treasury action, compelled bank transfers, Federal Reserve receiving/holding/investing/transferring, implementation, definitions, noncreation of enforceable rights and immediate/publication instructions were each considered. None supplies prospective independent transfer authority after express revocation. Section 4 protects qualifying historical conduct; its accrued effects are separately preserved. No actual administrative completion or congressional transmission event is inferred. Original section 4 protects completed transfers, good-faith conduct, and pre-transfer rights/debts/claims. EO13350 section 1 additionally saves matured rights/duties and proceedings. These are accrued consequences, not continued authority for new transfers under EO12817; the separate blocking continuation names EO12722/12724. Selected OFR later-order search is bounded to its reported catalog/saved-text scope; the eCFR search reaches2026-10-14. USC119-121 is only current through2026-10-09 and is not asserted as a complete cutoff predicate. No human approval or publication is asserted.
